integrity: General proof by an attained 1-Lipschitz potential. Finite BFS and transition tests are corroborative, not substitutes for infinite proof. Source comparisons are best-knowledge and do not guarantee uniqueness in all literature.
scientific_limitations: Exact target-by-target lengths are proved only for codimension-two images of the specified labeled Černý automata on n>=3 states. Prior results give maximum avoiding bounds, minimum rank-deficiency bounds, and broader two-defect reachability; no external independent validation is claimed.
title: A complete codimension-two reaching-distance spectrum for the Černý automata
